summary: Enroll in our training course on sustainable dairy farming practices. Equip yourself with knowledge to foster a greener, more productive dairy operation.
lede: Sustainable dairy farming training covers practical ways to assess and improve environmental performance across dairy operations. It is designed for agricultural professionals responsible for farm practices, with skills in emissions accounting, low-emission feed and nutrient planning, and assessing water use and herd welfare. Exercises apply these methods to farm data and turn findings into sustainability reports and action plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for agricultural professionals and supply chain leaders responsible for implementing and auditing environmental practices within dairy operations.
modules: Foundations of Sustainable Dairy and the DSF
Precision Nutrition and Enteric Methane Mitigation
Soil Health and Nutrient Management Planning
Precision Livestock Farming and IoT Integration
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of agricultural operations, livestock management, or dairy supply chains. Familiarity with basic environmental concepts and farm economics is recommended. No advanced data science or coding experience is required, but participants should be comfortable navigating spreadsheet-based calculation tools and reviewing digital dashboard interfaces. A laptop is required for hands-on exercises.
